# JS Supersonic

> Electronics, appliances and furniture, delivered across Mauritius. Online shop and 4 showrooms in Mauritius (Port Louis, Curepipe, Rose-Hill, Grand Baie).

Prices are in Mauritian rupees (Rs) and include VAT. Delivery is free on orders over Rs 5,000. Pay monthly over 6 to 36 months.

## Categories
- [TV & Audio](https://doorgesh3136.github.io/jssupersonic/category/tv-audio.html): 4K and QLED TVs from 43 to 75 inches, plus headphones and speakers that survive a day at the beach.
- [Phones & Tablets](https://doorgesh3136.github.io/jssupersonic/category/phones.html): Unlocked phones that work on my.t, Emtel and MTML, with a local warranty.
- [Computing](https://doorgesh3136.github.io/jssupersonic/category/computing.html): Laptops for school, the office and gaming, set up and ready when you collect.
- [Gaming](https://doorgesh3136.github.io/jssupersonic/category/gaming.html): Consoles and controllers, with stock on launch day for new releases.
- [Appliances & Cooling](https://doorgesh3136.github.io/jssupersonic/category/appliances.html): Fridges, washing machines and inverter air conditioners, delivered and installed.
- [Kitchen](https://doorgesh3136.github.io/jssupersonic/category/kitchen.html): Microwaves, cookers and coffee machines for everyday cooking.
- [Furniture & Bedding](https://doorgesh3136.github.io/jssupersonic/category/furniture.html): Sofas, beds and mattresses, delivered and assembled in your home.
